entities.summary: Sandra Maria Lima Suruagy is a Brazilian retired volleyball player who represented Brazil at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, where she earned a bronze medal with the Women's National Team. She also competed at the 1984 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles and the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul.
